title: Text message consent
notices: I agree to receive class, booking and billing notices and links from {gym}. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.
announcements: I agree to receive news from {gym}. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.
invalidPhone: Text messages need a valid phone number. Save a valid number first, including its country code if needed, before giving consent.
phoneChange: Changing the phone number clears its text message consent.
optedOut: This number replied STOP on {date}. Texts can't reach it until the person replies START to {gym}'s number.
optedOutStaff: Record verbal consent again only after the person confirms they replied START.
sameAsHousehold_on: This is also the household billing phone. Its billing notices consent is on.
sameAsHousehold_off: This is also the household billing phone. Its billing notices consent is off.
sameAsMember_on: This is also {name}'s own phone. Their notices consent is on.
sameAsMember_off: This is also {name}'s own phone. Their notices consent is off.
memberOnly: Only the member or a payer managing their profile can give announcements consent.
askFirst: Ask for verbal consent to notices before recording it. Staff may withdraw either choice.
failed: Consent could not be saved. Refresh and try again.
